description: Thommessen, Andre and colleagues describe this resource in the native deposit. Forecast site conditions drive wake estimates and individual turbine inflows. Simulated responses to a reference frequency event are optimized to find feasible inertia at turbine and farm levels under derating and operational constraints. Uncertainty from atmospheric forecasts and wake modelling is quantified. The companion pickle files contain published figures, not a stated complete raw simulation database, and the earlier extended abstract is grouped as supporting documentation. Source-code availability remains unknown. Zenodo provides the deposit with open access under cc-by-4.0. The source establishes an implemented or evaluated model. Public source-code availability remains unknown unless explicitly identified below. Coverage is limited to the stated experiment, model or application; transfer to other turbines, sites or operating regimes requires separate assessment. Publication date alone does not establish current maintenance.
